adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug. Looking at lines 1053-1062 in handleNewBooking.ts, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as `null` when both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are falsy. Then at line 1078, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining, which means if `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the push operation is skipped entirely. This means that for collective team events where the event type and organizer have no destination calendar but secondary hosts do have destination calendars, those secondary host calendars in `teamDestinationCalendars` will never be added. The fix would be to initialize `evt.destinationCalendar` as an empty array `[]` instead of `null` when no primary destination calendar exists, so the push can still add team member calendars.
